mapper.select: SELECT ST.SHOWTIME_ID, M.TITLE AS MOVIE_TITLE, T.THEATER_NAME, SC.NAME AS SCREEN_NAME, TO_CHAR(ST.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_AT, TO_CHAR(ST.END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_AT, ST.SEAT_COUNT, COUNT(SS.BOOKER_USER_UID) AS BOOKED_SEAT_COUNT FROM T_MOVIE_SHOWTIME ST JOIN MOVIE M ON M.MOVIE_ID = ST.MOVIE_ID JOIN T_THEATER T ON T.THEATER_ID = ST.THEATER_ID JOIN T_SCREEN SC ON SC.SCREEN_ID = ST.SCREEN_ID LEFT JOIN T_MOVIE_SHOWTIME_SEAT SS ON SS.SHOWTIME_ID = ST.SHOWTIME_ID GROUP BY ST.SHOWTIME_ID, M.TITLE, T.THEATER_NAME, SC.NAME, ST.START_AT, ST.END_AT, ST.SEAT_COUNT ORDER BY ST.START_AT DESC, ST.SHOWTIME_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MOVIE_SHOWTIME_SEAT (SHOWTIME_ID, SEAT_NO, BOOKER_USER_UID) SELECT #{showtimeId}, 'A' || LEVEL, NULL FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{seatCount}
